journey.title: Shopping and changes
journey.purpose: Review a week, shop against its derived list while preserving materially unchanged checks, and explicitly confirm purchases so a checkmark is never mistaken for a receipt.

steps.intent: Review the dated week and the meals that generate my shopping needs.
Check off items as shopping progresses without that changing stock or recording consumption.
Change a meal and keep the checked state for materially unchanged line requirements.
Explicitly add purchased quantities and prices to the pantry after a preview.

claims.statement: A meal change preserves checks for materially unchanged lines and marks only increased or changed requirements for review.
A confirmed purchase previews its changes and cannot apply the same purchase twice.
